expires_today.title: Picture Perfect - The Ultimate Photo & Video Bundle
expires_today.description: Enhance your photos and videos like a pro
expires_today.long_description: Give your photos and videos the polish they need with this bundle of editing software from Ashampoo! Take screenshots and annotate images and screengrabs with Snap Pro 26, get rid of glare and blurred lines with SHARPEN #6, choose what part of an image to highlight in high resolution with ZOOM #3, and more! Organize your library, denoise your photos, and add vibrancy and color to all of your digital projects with this bundle of professional tools at an accessible price! Grab this collection of Ashampoo apps and plugins for the price of your choice, and support the American Cancer Society with your purchase!

expires_today.title: The Ultimate Gene Wolfe Library by Tor Books
expires_today.description: New suns, ancient lands, and beyond
expires_today.long_description: Sci-fi and fantasy master Gene Wolfe’s novels and long-running series span all facets of genre fiction, each one unlike anything else ever written. For anyone looking to get into one of the greats, we’ve partnered with Tor Books to bring you the best of Gene Wolfe in one massive library! Enter the world of the genre-bending Book of the New Sun series with the Dying Earth fantasy of Shadow and Claw! Travel back to Ancient Greece with an amnesiac mercenary manipulated by the gods in Soldier of the Mist! Meet a young boy destined to become a warrior and more in the mythology remix The Knight! Nearly 40 novels, short story collections, and more are featured in this truly giant bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Alzheimer’s Research UK with your purchase!

expires_today.title: 2D Rewind Collection from S2 Games
expires_today.long_description:
Transport yourself back to the good old days with this bundle of arcade-inspired fun! From pixelated beat-’em-ups to combat strategy games, this bundle has plenty of retro delights for the modern day. Hit the streets with the hot-blooded scrappers of River City Girls and River City Girls 2! Traverse the endless void in an evolving spaceship in Nova Drift! Play the slots and build your deck to make rent money in Luck Be a Landlord. Special thanks to S2 Games for making this collection possible! There’s even more 2D adventure to be had in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choosing, and help support the Starlight Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 21st, 2027.

expires_today.title: Joe Haldeman: The Forever War and Beyond by Open Road Media
expires_today.description: The future worlds of Joe Haldeman
expires_today.long_description: Meet one of the masters of science fiction in this collection of books by the one and only Joe Haldeman! See where it all started with his Nebula, Hugo, and Locus Award winning novel The Forever War, a drama of civilizations trapped in interstellar conflict! Embark on a nailbiting trip to the surface of a future Earth threatened by a terrorist plot in Worlds! Follow an intergalactic spy wracked with guilt over dangerous missions in All My Sins Remembered! There’s even more to explore in this bundle of 17 of Joe Haldeman’s greatest sci-fi stories, so grab them now at the price of your choice and support Active Minds charity with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Best Core Game Dev Assets & Tools Megabundle
expires_today.long_description: If you’ve got the narrative, we’ve got the assets and toolkits to bring your next game idea to reality! The Best Core Game Dev Assets & Tools bundle includes Hyper Combat Framework, Attribute Manager, Building and Farming systems. Also included are environment packs for a myriad of locales like space, feudal Japanese villages, ancient forests, and more. Get over $2700 worth of game development assistance, all while supporting Girls Who Code with your purchase. <iframe width="400" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/YCFketQ0KqA?si=Ozmc5xwBZxpUh5SR" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

expires_today.title: Ultimate SFX for Games
expires_today.long_description: Function Loops has assembled a massive collection that brings together 3 bundles and 44 packs total, including fresh sample packs never released before. On top of that, they’ve added a brand new VST plugin, loaded with 4 expansions for drums & percussion design. Spanning retro production, cinematic scoring, drums & percussion, game sounds & FX, ambiences, and modern electronic sound design, this bundle delivers over $1,500 USD worth of sounds and tools, ready to drop into your next video game, soundtrack, or production. Plus, a portion of your purchase benefits Music Will and their goal of spreading music education to all.

expires_today.title: Bundle - Indie Fears
expires_today.long_description:
Get into the spooky season with this new bundle of the creepiest indie games around! Discover what all the fuss is about with the much-memed space-set nightmare fuel game Mouthwashing. Keep a mystery train running and try not to run out of oxygen on the steep mountain slopes of Threshold. Flip burgers and keep your customers satisfied in the spooky cooking simulator send-up Kiosk. Those aren’t even the tip of the horror game iceberg featured in this bundle, so name your price and help support the Prevent Cancer Foundation charity with your purchase. And maybe keep a light on while you play. You never know.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 14th, 2027.

expires_today.title: 50 Essential Fantagraphics Titles by Fantagraphics
expires_today.long_description: A classic alien invasion thriller! An iconic Sunday strip adventure! A murder investigation with a pulpy twist! When it comes to publishing great comics, Fantagraphics knows what’s up, and if you’ve been looking to get into what this fantastic publisher has to offer, we’ve collected 50 of Fantagraphics’ best titles in one bundle! Solve the murder of a mysterious woman alongside a horror-obsessed 10-year-old in My Favorite Thing Is Monsters! Escape to an era of medieval swordfights and epic adventures with the first two collected volumes of Prince Valiant! Fight back against a devastating alien invasion in the subversive Argentine masterwork The Eternaut! All of these and many more are featured in this bundle of 50—yes, F-I-F-T-Y—of Fantagraphics’ best titles, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support the Freedom of the Press Foundation with your purchase!

expires_today.title: SkullForge Studios Arsenal Mega Bundle
expires_today.long_description: Pay what you want for the ultimate collection of Arsenal printable minis for any occasion or the hit tabletop skirmish game by SkullForge Studios! This action-packed game pits fireteams of badass mercenaries against each other for contract payouts and glory. Each fireteam plays 5 drop troopers and 1 mega mech known as MCVs. Our Mega Bundle assembles hundreds of unique playables from terrain to vanguards like Arsenal Terrain: Mech Bay and Crew and Arsenal Fireteam: Zeta. Dominate the combat zone alongside your friends and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Create Magic with Magix
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Breeze through photo, musical, or video projects with professional‑quality tools by MAGIX. Unlock advanced video editing software built with precision and speed in mind with MAGIX Video Pro X16, easy music production with loops from every genre and a drag‑and‑drop workflow from Music Maker 2025 Premium, customize slideshows that turn photos into dynamic stories with Photostory deluxe 2025, and so much more! Turn bold ideas into powerful stories with the Create Magic with MAGIX Bundle, and help support Children's Miracle Network with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Dungeon Adventures! - 3D Printable Miniatures & Scenery
expires_within_72h.long_description: Your campaign is as real as you make it, so why not give it some life? Fill your dungeons with characters and scenery with this bundle of 3D printable miniatures from Hayland Terrain and Warp Miniatures! Get over 90 software files for absolutely everything you need—from giant ants and bats to rock elementals, spooky sewer entrances, tombs, market stalls, and more! Build your environments and fill them with characters, creatures, and tons of detail to give your players a whole world of adventure! Grab this bundle at the brice of your choice, and support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Gamer's Kitchen Cookbooks by Insight Editions
expires_within_72h.description: Games have never looked so delicious
expires_within_72h.long_description: Cook your way through your favorite games with this bundle of official and unofficial video game recipe books! Fry up tasty street food and mix some criminally delicious cocktails with An Unofficial Grand Theft Auto Cookbook! Fill up on sweetrolls and brew an apple cabbage stew any tavern keeper would envy with The Elder Scrolls: The Official Cookbook! Quench your thirst with the Wasteland-inspired libations in Fallout: The Official Drinks Book! Throw a gamer dinner party or cook up a multi-course meal for one with the 27 recipe books included in this collection! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support NatureBridge with your purchase!
